correctness.rationale: For every prime power q≡1 mod9, s=(q-1)/3, cubic-residue subgroup K of size s and mu3⊂K, the coefficient change a_u=u^k c(u) bijects the three copies of K. The map f_c multiplies each multiplicative fiber by a_u and is always a permutation; f_c+X permutes iff 1+a_u nonzero and image fiber indices i+j_i form a permutation. Three rotations require constant shift j, three transpositions shift triples are permutations of 0,1,2, giving R=sum_j N_j³, T=3∏N_j. The character sum S=sum_{a∈K}χ(1+a)=(J(χ,χ)-2)/3 follows from χ(-1)=1 and mixed Jacobi sum -1, yielding N_j=(q-4+ζ^-j(J-2)+ζ^j(conj J-2))/9. Orthogonality and cubic factorization yield strict R−T=(q-4)|J-2|²/27, |J|=sqrt(q)>2. The q→∞ expansions require retaining ∑d_j² and O(q^3/2) cubic terms and dividing by s³, yielding 2/9−5/(3q)+O(q^-3/2). Independently enumerated prime fields q=19,37,73: N=[2,1,2],[2,5,4],[8,6,9], (R,T)=(17,12),(197,120),(1457,1296), respectively, and Jacobi-norm identity; original verifier also treats characteristic two q=64. These finite tests do not replace the cubic character proof.
